svg.title: Endometrial pathway scores across three cohorts

cc:Work.dc:title: Endometrial pathway scores across three cohorts
cc:Work.dc:description: Case minus control in within-cohort percentile points. The five-pathway mean is Finland (Whole-tissue array) +1.77, Rome (Whole-tissue array) -2.68, Switzerland (Donor-first ranks) +0.71, Switzerland (Cell-first ranks) +0.31. Each of the five individual pathways is also shown. The ranking universe differs by assay.

g.text: Each pathway uses the same measured genes across cohorts. Positive values indicate higher scores in cases.

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475b64

g.text: Finland and Rome rank features on their respective arrays. Switzerland ranks 29,034 glandular epithelial features.

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475b64

g.text: The Swiss donor-first joint test gave an exact two-sided p of 0.167 (24 of 144 allocations within capture batches).
